factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Statements: Net loss widened to €1,154k (2025) from €786k (2024). Operating loss increased to €940k (2025) from €547k (2024). EBITDA deteriorated to -€420k (2025) from -€25k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Gross profit declined to €603 thousand from €771 thousand, while EBITDA fell to a negative €420 thousand from a negative €25 thousand, reducing the EBITDA margin from 0% to negative 6%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss: Gross profit €603k (2025) vs €771k (2024). EBITDA -€420k (2025) vs -€25k (2024). Financial Ratios table: EBITDA margin -6% (2025) vs 0% (2024).

factual_claims.claim: The operating loss widened to €940 thousand from €547 thousand, and the net loss increased to €1.154 million from €786 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss: Operating loss €940k (2025) vs €547k (2024). Net loss €1,154k (2025) vs €786k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: The net margin consequently declined from negative 10% to negative 16%, while basic and diluted loss per share improved from €0.17 to €0.14 because the number of shares nearly doubled.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Ratios table: Net margin -16% (2025) vs -10% (2024). Note 14: Basic/diluted loss per share €0.14 (2025) vs €0.17 (2024). Share capital increased from 4,499,061 shares to 8,499,061 shares (Note 13).

factual_claims.claim: The fibreboard segment reported negative EBITDA of €296 thousand compared with positive EBITDA of €26 thousand in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 22: EBITDA by business segments - Fibreboard production and sales: -€296k (2025) vs €26k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Management attributed the deterioration to underutilised production capacity and the planned December factory shutdown for the transition to a new gas boiler house.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: Negative EBITDA in 2025 attributable to factory shutdown in December for transition to new gas boiler house. Also cites underutilised capacity increasing production costs.

factual_claims.claim: Personnel, maintenance and repair costs continued during the shutdown, reducing EBITDA by approximately €0.2 million.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow remained negative and worsened to €503 thousand from €174 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows: Net cash from operating activities -€503k (2025) vs -€174k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Investing cash outflows increased to €989 thousand, including €1.367 million invested in production assets and €161 thousand in real estate.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows: Net cash used in investing activities €989k. Breakdown: Purchase of property, plant and equipment €1,367k; Purchase of real estate investment €161k.

factual_claims.claim: Financing activities generated €1.444 million, including a €2 million share issue completed in October 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows: Net cash from financing activities €1,444k. Share capital increase €2,000k (Note 13). Management Report: Share issue completed in October 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Consequently, the net cash outflow was €48 thousand and closing cash declined to €5 thousand from €53 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows: Net change in cash -€48k. Cash and cash equivalents: €5k (2025) vs €53k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Total assets increased to €9.323 million from €8.252 million, mainly reflecting higher fixed assets and inventories.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: Total assets €9,323k (2025) vs €8,252k (2024). Fixed assets increased from €7,004k to €7,494k. Inventories increased from €624k to €1,034k.

factual_claims.claim: Equity rose to €4.462 million from €3.616 million following the share issue, partly offset by the annual loss.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity: Total equity €4,462k (2025) vs €3,616k (2024). Share premium increased by €1,600k due to share issue (Note 13), partially offset by net loss of €1,154k.

factual_claims.claim: Borrowings declined to €3.168 million from €3.724 million, but working capital was negative by €2.7 million compared with €0.7 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: Borrowings €3,168k (2025) vs €3,724k (2024). Note 25: Working capital negative €2.7m (2025) vs negative €0.7m (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Management plans to address this through property sales.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 25: Management plans to liquidate negative working capital by selling properties at Suur-Jõe Street 48 and Admirali Street.

factual_claims.claim: The Group also merged Pärnu Riverside Development OÜ into Nordic Fibreboard AS and completed the Admirali Quarter project design and permitting.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 1: Merger of Pärnu Riverside Development OÜ into Nordic Fibreboard AS with balance sheet date 01.06.2025. Real Estate Management section: Design work completed; building permits issued for Admirali Quarter development project.

factual_claims.claim: In January 2026, a preliminary agreement was signed for the sale of the ten development properties, while the boiler-house upgrade was completed.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
